page.overview:
What is Yuba Oasis?

Yuba Oasis is a non-canon oasis town in Mr. Kuromaku's version of Arabasta, run by ック・ワークス|Furokku Wākusu}}.

Unlike in the One Piece world, the oasis located here did not dry up, and the location was transformed into a resort by "Furo"que Works. It has a heavy gambling industry, centered around pulling gamblers into debt and forcing them to work it off.

Yuba Oasis is split up into three main sections, being a water park, casino, and underground factory.

The water park contains multiple slides and pools despite the surrounding desert, a testament to the present oasis. It also contains street stalls selling food. This region is used as a draw to customers, with nearly free access; "Furo"que Works intends for visitors to begin here and funnel over to the casino.
